title: T09 half-plane classification and segment intersection contract

modules.name: halfplane_classifier

ports.name: start_i
ports.description: Accept one point and constraint while idle

ports.name: constant_c_i
ports.description: Signed constraint constant with 46 fractional bits

ports.name: function_value_o
ports.description: Saturated signed f=a*x+b*y-c with 46 fractional bits

ports.name: inside_o
ports.description: Function value is at least negative epsilon

ports.name: margin_used_o
ports.description: Negative value accepted only by tolerance

ports.name: arithmetic_saturated_o
ports.description: Wide evaluation exceeded the 66-bit result range

behavior: Classify the point inside when f is greater than or equal to -2^30.
Assert margin_used only for values in the closed interval from -2^30 through -1.
Complete four clocks after accepting start.
constraints: Coordinates use signed Q16.16 and coefficients use signed Q2.30.
The constant and function result use 46 fractional bits.
A start while busy is rejected and emits one protocol error pulse.
corner_cases: The negative epsilon boundary is inside and uses the margin.
Zero is inside without using the margin.
Out-of-range function values saturate and set arithmetic_saturated.
verification_cases: Check positive, zero, negative epsilon, and below-epsilon values.
Check positive saturation and busy-start rejection.

timing_diagrams.title: Four-cycle half-plane evaluation
timing_diagrams.description: Two products, one sum, and one output stage follow start acceptance.

modules.name: segment_intersection

ports.name: start_i
ports.description: Accept one segment and endpoint function pair

ports.name: start_value_i
ports.description: Signed function value at segment start

ports.name: end_value_i
ports.description: Signed function value at segment end

ports.name: intersection_valid_o
ports.description: Intersection coordinates are valid this clock

ports.name: parallel_o
ports.description: Denominator magnitude did not exceed epsilon

ports.name: ratio_q2_30_o
ports.description: Clamped interpolation ratio from zero through one in Q2.30

behavior: Form denominator as start_value minus end_value.
Reject denominator magnitudes at or below 2^30 as parallel.
Use a 30-round restoring fractional divider and round the Q2.30 ratio to nearest.
Clamp the ratio to the closed interval from zero through one.
Interpolate both coordinates with nearest rounding and signed 32-bit saturation.
constraints: General non-degenerate division completes 37 clocks after start acceptance.
Endpoint or clamped-ratio paths complete in six clocks.
The near-parallel path completes in two clocks without a valid point.
A start while busy is rejected and emits one protocol error pulse.
corner_cases: A zero start value returns the start point.
A denominator exactly equal to epsilon is parallel.
One-third and two-thirds ratios use nearest rounding.
verification_cases: Check midpoint, one-third, two-thirds, and start-endpoint intersections.
Check the first denominator above epsilon and the exact-epsilon parallel case.
Check all latency classes, pulse widths, and busy-start rejection.
